assemblyCoverage.crane: Reuse V3_CraneTruss + V3_ScaffoldBay; retain existing moving cable/winch/pivot assembly. New shells never replace collision or swing geometry.
assemblyCoverage.viaduct: Repeat V3_ArchPortal + V3_RailBed; close visible ends with V3_FacadeStrip/solid native abutment. Test all joins in Pass2.
assemblyCoverage.terminal: V3_Terminal_Wing + V3_ClockTower + V3_GableRoof_Narrow/Wide + V3_TerminalColonnade + V3_BarrelRoof + V3_Sign_Terminal.
assemblyCoverage.course: All existing gameplay transforms, tags, settings and trigger dimensions must be preserved from live source before Pass2.

package.importStrategy: Import shared package once; clone canonical imported meshes. Verify shared image ContentId, scale, pivots and opaque flags in Roblox before assembly.
